const dynamic = [
    [/^TODAY(?: (\d+))?$/, (_match, count) => (count ? `今天 ${count}` : "今天")],
    [/^(\d+)m$/, (_match, count) => `${count} 分钟前`],
    [/^(\d+)h$/, (_match, count) => `${count} 小时前`],
    [/^(\d+)d$/, (_match, count) => `${count} 天前`],
    [
        /^(\d+) older branches are not listed\.$/,
        (_match, count) => `还有 ${count} 个更早的分支未列出。`,
    ],
    [
        /^Size: (.+)\. Switch to (.+)$/,
        (_match, size, preset) => `尺寸：${size}。切换到${t(preset)}`,
    ],
    [
        /^(Archived|Unarchived) “(.+)”\. Tap to undo\.$/,
        (_match, action, title) =>
            `${action === "Archived" ? "已归档" : "已取消归档"}“${title}”。点击撤销。`,
    ],
    [/^Desktop · (.+)$/, (_match, theme) => `桌面 · ${theme}`],
    [/^Show all (\d+) lines$/, (_match, count) => `显示全部 ${count} 行`],
    [/^(\d+) coming$/, (_match, count) => `${count} 项待执行`],
    [
        /^Back to sessions, (\d+) waiting for you$/,
        (_match, count) => `返回会话列表，${count} 项待你处理`,
    ],
    [/^Image from (.+)$/, (_match, host) => `图片来源：${host}`],
    [/^No model matches “(.+)”\.$/, (_match, query) => `没有匹配的模型：“${query}”。`],
    [/^No branch matches “(.+)”\.$/, (_match, query) => `没有匹配的分支：“${query}”。`],
    [/^No file matches “(.+)”\.$/, (_match, query) => `没有匹配的文件：“${query}”。`],
    [/^Nothing here says “(.+)”\.$/, (_match, query) => `这里没有提到“${query}”。`],
    [/^Nothing matches “(.+)”\.$/, (_match, query) => `没有匹配项：“${query}”。`],
];

/** Translate exact UI labels and known dynamic UI patterns; leave other content untouched. */
export function t(value) {
    if (typeof value !== "string") {
        return value;
    }

    if (Object.hasOwn(strings, value)) {
        return strings[value];
    }

    const leading = value.match(/^\s*/)?.[0] ?? "";
    const trailing = value.match(/\s*$/)?.[0] ?? "";
    const end = value.length - trailing.length;
    const text = value.slice(leading.length, end || undefined);
    const translated = Object.hasOwn(strings, text) ? strings[text] : undefined;

    if (translated !== undefined) {
        return `${leading}${translated}${trailing}`;
    }

    for (const [pattern, translate] of dynamic) {
        const match = pattern.exec(text);

        if (match) {
            return `${leading}${translate(...match)}${trailing}`;
        }
    }

    return value;
}
